style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft blush vanity beauty-tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, blush pink #F3CFC9 and cream #F7F1E8 backgrounds with cocoa text #4A342E and one coral accent #E08A7B; warm soft diffused studio lighting from the front-left with low contrast, soft long contact shadows and no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent rounded cream cards and thin cocoa line icons at one stroke weight; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; slim product upright or on a clean diagonal with the narrow neck as the visual axis, stable scale across the set, and every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cold blue or navy styling.
noDrift: no cold blue or navy styling
style.presentationRules: slim product always upright or lying on a clean diagonal with the narrow neck as the visual axis, brush head and collar joint always fully visible, stable scale across the set, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: seamless blush vanity wall #F3CFC9, satin cream pedestal and card #F7F1E8, glossy blush floor with soft reflection pooling, smooth white macro ground #FFFFFF, blush pink marbled liquid texture #F6D2CB with creamy swirls #FBEDE6
